scope: All 113 lesson caption keys in each of the six assigned locales; 678 captions reviewed against the revised Japanese and English source. Other content keys retained.
display_unit_format: A literal newline is an authored display boundary. Each unit is one complete sentence. No sentence-width, word-count or line-count segmentation is authored by a runtime heuristic.
review_criteria: One complete grammatical sentence per display unit; punctuation inside a version or number remains untouched.
Preserved target machines, item identity, recipes, amounts, conditions, causal relations and order; retained official item names, including awkward upstream pt_pt terms.
Separated combined operations and explanatory clauses into independently readable complete sentences.
Retained ore-block/raw-ore distinctions, unified chemical system in 1.21.1 and radiation precautions.
No English fallback and no font-size reduction or omission.

continuation_policy.reason: These captions can be rewritten as short complete sentences without an authored clause continuation. No ellipsis markers were added merely to fit the box. Runtime continuation validation is owned by the primary implementation.

examples.before: Configura como Output la cara del producto y activa la expulsión automática de objetos para enviarlos a un destino adyacente compatible.
after_units: Configura como Output la cara del producto.
Activa la expulsión automática de objetos.
Los productos van a un destino adyacente compatible.
examples.reason: Separates output setting, auto-eject and its adjacent-target effect without dropping compatibility.

examples.before: Briser un appareil ou un tuyau contenant des produits chimiques radioactifs peut libérer des radiations. Avant le démontage, dirige le contenu vers un traitement sûr et vérifie dans l’interface que tout est vide.
after_units: Les appareils et tuyaux peuvent contenir des produits chimiques radioactifs.
Les briser dans cet état peut libérer des radiations.
Dirige le contenu vers un traitement sûr.
Avant le démontage, vérifie dans l’interface que les récipients sont vides.
examples.reason: Keeps radioactive chemical contents and release risk, then gives safe processing and empty-container checks before dismantling.

examples.before: In Minecraft 1.21.1 verwenden Sauerstoff, Wasserstoff, Infusionsmaterialien und Schlämme das vereinheitlichte Chemikaliensystem. Flüssigkeiten bleiben getrennt.
after_units: In Mekanism 1.21.1 gibt es ein einheitliches Chemikaliensystem.
Es umfasst Sauerstoff, Wasserstoff, Infusionsmaterialien und Schlämme.
Flüssigkeiten bleiben getrennt.
examples.reason: Explains the unified chemical system, its members and the separate fluid system as three complete statements.

examples.before: A Câmara de Dissolução Química usa ácido sulfúrico. Um bloco de minério de ferro produz 1.000 mB de lama suja; três Ferros Brutos produzem 2.000 mB.
after_units: A Câmara de Dissolução Química usa ácido sulfúrico.
Um bloco de minério de ferro produz 1.000 mB de lama suja.
Três Ferros Brutos produzem 2.000 mB de lama suja.
examples.reason: States ore-block and Raw Iron slurry yields separately while preserving 1.000/2.000 mB.

examples.before: Este corte remove temporariamente a armação da frente. Coloca lá dentro uma célula e um fornecedor: as células definem a capacidade de energia e os fornecedores, o limite de transferência.
after_units: Este corte remove temporariamente a armação da frente.
Coloca lá dentro uma célula e um fornecedor.
As células definem a capacidade de energia.
Os fornecedores definem o limite de transferência.
examples.reason: Separates the cutaway, placement and distinct cell/provider roles into complete sentences.

examples.before: Il Cristallizzatore chimico lavora fanghiglia in lotti da 200 mB. Quantità parziali distribuite tra più macchine possono restare inutilizzate anche se il totale basta.
after_units: Il Cristallizzatore chimico lavora fanghiglia in lotti da 200 mB.
Lotti parziali divisi tra macchine possono bloccare la lavorazione.
Un totale sufficiente non garantisce un lotto completo per macchina.
examples.reason: Distinguishes total slurry amount from a complete 200 mB batch per machine.
